name: Claude Code v2.1.318
hook: Today's release (Nov 4) adds an `effort` option to `$.model.fork` so parallel side-jobs can run at a lower reasoning level — a direct cost-saver for routine subagent work. Also ships: `assume_role` on mantle gateway upstreams for cross-account AWS roles and per-developer cost attribution; `loginExpiresAt` in `claude auth status`; and cloud sessions can now start without selecting a repository first.

name: UI UX Pro Max
hook: 145k stars. Design intelligence skill that gives Claude Code 79 searchable UI styles, 192 industry-matched color palettes, 74 Google Fonts pairings, 119 UX accessibility guidelines, and 22 tech stacks (React, Next.js, SwiftUI, Flutter, Jetpack Compose, and more). A `--persist` flag writes a `MASTER.md` brand file for consistency across sessions; a theme-migration command reskins existing apps to a chosen style.

name: Ponytail
hook: 184k stars (+3k since first featured Oct 31). Forces coding agents through a seven-rung pre-coding ladder before writing a line: is it needed, already in the codebase, in stdlib, a platform primitive, installed dep, or a one-liner? Benchmarks: 53% less code, 26% less cost, 45% fewer tokens vs. no skill. Adds `/ponytail-review`, `/ponytail-audit`, and a status band showing cost + code-reuse in real time.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 5 — 184k stars, +3k since Oct 31 first feature

name: claude-mem
hook: 113k stars on the claude-code GitHub topic (Nov 4). Persistent memory compression system for AI coding agents — automatically captures tool-usage observations each session, generates semantic summaries, and injects the most relevant context back into future sessions. Agent-agnostic since v13: works with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex. Web viewer at localhost:37777 shows your full memory graph. The quick-start is a single command; a note in the README warns that `npm install -g` installs only the SDK — `npx claude-mem install` does the full hook+worker setup.

name: Caveman
hook: 117k stars. Forces coding agents to reply in terse, caveman-style prose while leaving code and commands exact. Independent measurements: 33.2% fewer input tokens per session (own benchmark), 54% lower cost vs. Opus 5.5 at xhigh effort via smart routing, and 63.6% fewer response tokens in Elastic's MCP scenarios. Adobe Research independently confirmed 1.4–2.4× savings across 8 models. Apache-2.0.

name: ECC (Enhanced Coding Context)
hook: 296k stars, updated Nov 2. Comprehensive agent-harness performance overlay: 71 specialized agents, 314 on-demand skills, 98 slash-command shims, hooks-based session memory, and AgentShield security scanning (flags hardcoded secrets, permission misconfigs, MCP risks in your .claude/ directory). Works on Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor. One setup command installs the whole stack.

name: Graphify
hook: 142k stars. Parses code, docs, PDFs, images, and video into a traversable knowledge graph (no embeddings, no vector store) — each edge tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED. Installs a `/graphify` skill and hooks that redirect file-search tool calls to the graph instead of grepping. Self-reported benchmarks: 0.497 recall@10 on LOCOMO and 76% QA accuracy on LongMemEval-S with zero LLM credits for graph building. ~40 languages.
install:
uv tool install graphifyy
graphify install

name: Paperclip
hook: 111k stars on the claude-code GitHub topic (Nov 4). Open-source, self-hosted orchestration platform that treats AI agents like employees: each agent gets a role, a reporting structure, and a ticket queue. Budgets, approval gates, and tool restrictions are enforced per agent. Paperclip doesn't run agents itself — it plugs into Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and others through adapters, then schedules them in short event-triggered heartbeat sessions. MIT, launched March 2026.

name: Agentic Awesome Skills
hook: 49.1k stars, still actively updated Nov 4. name: Planning With Files
hook: 27.9k stars, updated Nov 4. Manus-style working memory on disk: keeps `task_plan.md`, `findings.md`, and `progress.md` in your project so the plan survives `/clear`, context compaction, and crashes. Hooks re-inject selected planning context every turn. In gated mode, the agent's stop is held until all phases are ticked off. SHA-256 tamper attestation blocks injection if an approved plan is changed externally. Works with 60+ agents.
